name: Altstadthotel Weisses Kreuz
beschreibung: The Altstadthotel Weisses Kreuz is located in the historic old town of Innsbruck. Nearby sights include the Golden Roof (Goldenes Dachl) and the Imperial Palace (Hofburg). The rooms feature private bathrooms and complimentary Wi-Fi access. Dating back to the 16th century, the building blends historic architecture with modern amenities. A buffet breakfast is served daily. Guests will appreciate the relaxed ambiance and immediate access to the pedestrian zone.
